headword: {交感|こうかん}{神経|しんけい}

definitions.explanation: the part of the autonomic nervous system that activates the body's fight-or-flight response, increasing heart rate, blood pressure, and alertness

notes:
Part of the ⟦{自律|じりつ}{神経|しんけい}→自律神経：08621_jiritsushinkei⟧ (autonomic nervous system), responsible for the body's active, alert state. Composed of {交感|こうかん} (sympathetic, responsive) + ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (nerve). Commonly discussed in health articles about stress, sleep, and relaxation techniques.
